review: I like the one-mechanic-per-stage structure, and Gauntlet recombines spikes, lasers, springs, ferries and crumble tiles well. But the curve is bumpy. First Steps kills 29 of 100 ghosts on a spike cluster, which is harsh for a tutorial. Saw Mill is the real problem: it opens with several moving saws at once, never shows one safe saw first, and only half of mid-skill players pass. Ferry Lines also sits below the band and mostly kills by pits. Then Spring Loaded is a 93% breather with almost no risk. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are the best-tuned, readable stages.
best: Laser Gate and Crumble Bridge teach one clear idea with readable, fair deaths.
worst: Saw Mill tests saws in groups before it teaches a single one, so stage 3 is a difficulty spike.
